title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny
description: As the Dragon Master, Po has endured his fair share of epic challenges but nothing could prepare him for his greatest one yet-as a Kung Fu teacher to a group of rambunctious kids from Panda Village who have been imbued with a mysterious and powerful chi energy. Together they embark on amazing adventures, battle ferocious villains, and become legends!

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 1x1
episodes_data.description: After absorbing the mystical Hero Chi of the Four Constellations, four panda kids enlist the Dragon Master to teach them Kung Fu

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 1x2
episodes_data.description: When the kids grow over-confident after beginning their training, they decide to intercept a distress call and sneak off without permission, only to land themselves in hot water

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 1x3
episodes_data.description: Po and the kids are recruited to perform in Mei Mei's theatrical show, but things take a turn when Jindiao ruins the play in order to find a mystical scroll

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 1x4
episodes_data.description: When Jindiao arrives to the Village, he invites the kids to participate in an exhibition match, but has alternative motives

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 1x5
episodes_data.description: When Po discovers he was poisoned, he sets off to a caravan oasis in the hopes of finding out who the perpetrator is, unknowingly followed by the kids

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 1x6
episodes_data.description: When Po and the kids stop for the night at an Inn, they meet a gang who wants to fight Po and end up down a path to uncovering Jindiao's evil plan

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 1x7
episodes_data.description: The kids must leave Po to escape into the forest and head back to Panda Village to prepare against Jindiao

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 1x8
episodes_data.description: The kids meet an unlikely ally when trying to find Po

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 1x9
episodes_data.description: After a shocking revelation, Po is determined to get his chi back and Jing decides to face Jindiao

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 1x10
episodes_data.description: The kids go to the Spirit Realm and meet the Original Four Constellations in the hopes of learning how to defeat Jindiao

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 1x11
episodes_data.description: Jindiao takes Po and the kids hostage in an attempt to locate the Wellspring

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 1x12
episodes_data.description: The kids are desperate to get back and help their fellow Panda Villagers, and Po decides he must figure out a way to defeat Jindiao before he controls the world

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 1x13
episodes_data.description: Po, the kids, and the new Panda Guardians must work together to defeat Jindiao once and for all, and get a visit from an unlikely source

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 2x1
episodes_data.description: Feeling a little bored with their new hero life, Po and the kids are excited to accept an important invitation to the Forbidden City. Meanwhile, there's a curious disturbance deep in Panda Village.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 2x2
episodes_data.description: Po and the Kids take a shortcut to the boat bound for the Forbidden City, and are waylaid by a tricky monkey. Zhizhu informs Mayor Li of some distressing sounds coming from the Wellspring.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 2x3
episodes_data.description: When Po and eventually the kids finally make it on the Riverboat, they discover old friends, new enemies, and perplexing cargo.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 2x4
episodes_data.description: Po and the Kids are once more waylaid, this time by Mole Rats who have deemed Bao their god. But when Bao isn't able to defeat the mythical creature plaguing the Wasteland, Fan Tong steps up to save the day.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 2x5
episodes_data.description: Po and the Kids finally arrive in the Forbidden City. After an assassination scare, Xiao enlists Po and the Four Constellations for help protecting her during her father's funeral.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 2x6
episodes_data.description: Po and the Kids agree to escort a dirigible shipment of food to a drought-torn region of China. But Nu Hai has some suspicions about Shi Long, which she finds aren't far off when she discovers the dirigible is set to explode...with them on board!

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 2x7
episodes_data.description: Po and the Kids make it to Gongmen City in search of the contact they heard has some info on the dirigible crash. Meanwhile, Xiao, mourning the presumed death of her new panda friends, takes off into the woods and meets a new friend.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 2x8
episodes_data.description: In a giant sea battle, Po and the Kids manage to escape the pursuing police to make it to Volcano island and get some answers. Empress Xiao begins learning how to defend herself.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 2x9
episodes_data.description: On the Volcano Island, Po and the Kids are reunited with Li, Grandma, Ping, Rooster, Wing, and Wong, and work together to find out what's really going on the island. Xiao becomes suspicious of some of her royal workers.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 2x10
episodes_data.description: The whole gang escapes pursing Guards, battles flowing lava, and survives crumbling caves and pillars to finally make it back to the Forbidden City. Xiao is ready to escape the palace, but Shi Long has other plans for her.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 2x11
episodes_data.description: The gang learns of even bigger and direr forces working against the Empress and the Kingdom of China, and must come up with a plan to put a stop to it before it is too late.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 2x12
episodes_data.description: When things don't quite go according to plan, Po and the Kids must rally with other allies to save the Empress and protect China.

episodes_data.title: Kung Fu Panda: The Paws of Destiny 2x13
episodes_data.description: Po and the Kids are put to the ultimate test, and must use all their knowledge and skills in order to defeat The White Bone Demon.
